biotools.summary: 'BioDockify is a cloud-native AI platform for pharmaceutical research and drug discovery. It integrates molecular docking (AutoDock Vina, GNINA), GPU-accelerated GROMACS molecular dynamics simulation, ADMET prediction, QSAR modelling, AI literature intelligence, and scientific writing into a unified browser-based workspace. Free tier available. No installation required
biotools.name: BioDockify
